_comment: Recorded goldens for the Qwen3.6-35B-A3B Model Runner V2 regression in vLLM-Ascend.
The reference is Model Runner V1 on vLLM-Ascend v0.30.0: Model Runner V1 was removed afterwards,
so the frozen release is the only reproducible place to record it. Regenerate by running the model
on v0.30.0 with greedy decoding and the settings below, then store the emitted token ids together
with the top-20 logprobs of each step. Do not hand-edit token ids.
Entries are keyed <arch>_tp<tp>_<graph_mode>; a TP=1 recording must never be reused for TP=2.

meta.reference_runner: Model Runner V2 on main + the Qwen3.6 compatibility patch
meta.reference_release: model runner V2, `main` + PR #21745 patch (recorded on a nightly-main image)
meta.note: Recorded with Model Runner V2 on a main-based image with the compatibility patch applied (fp32 dequant scale + fp32 mamba state). Model Runner V1 no longer exists on main, so a main-native recording is the only reference this suite can reproduce. The Model Runner V1 parity evidence is separate and lives on the v0.30.0 release: 11 cross-runner pairs, all token-identical, max same-token logprob delta 1.55e-06. On the eager/TP=1/24-token case the two stacks agree for 19 tokens and then flip a near-tie (delta 0.1297, inside the 0.1378 decode tolerance), which is why a v0.30.0-recorded golden cannot be asserted on main.
